description: Use when the question is about search performance for one site. Set view: overview (clicks, impressions, CTR, position with prior-period deltas; days), pages (top landing pages; days/limit), queries (top queries; days/limit), monthly (archive row; month), quick_wins (striking-distance queries with click headroom), decay (pages losing clicks across equal windows, labeled content-aging vs ranking-drop; windowDays), cannibalization (queries split across several pages), weekly_report (one-call weekly summary: totals, winners, losers, new queries). For a ranked fix list use get_opportunities; for one page across sources use get_page_report. Unconnected or free-tier sites return na with a reason, never zeros.
